data.value: Will NASA's senior managers publicly announce a go decision for Apollo 11's July launch window at the conclusion of the flight readiness review process before the end of June 1969?

The flight readiness review process for Apollo 11 is ongoing. A public announcement of a go decision for the July launch window would be made by senior managers after the review concludes. The review is expected to be completed before the end of June 1969.
